filler.file: LongMemEval_S (cleaned), user turns from every haystack

settings.store: SqliteMemoryStore(':memory:'), every item a plain fact (validFrom = when it was said), told in date order

systems.al-buddy: HybridRetriever(store, LocalEmbedder).recall(q, { limit: 20, validAt: now, expand: true }), as the MCP recall tool runs it
systems.al-buddy-keyword: HybridRetriever(store).recall(q, { limit: 20, validAt: now, expand: true }): no embedder
systems.fts: store.searchNodes({ query: q, limit: 20, validAt: now }): FTS5 bm25 over the first 16 words, OR-ed
systems.bm25: Okapi BM25, k1 1.2, b 0.75, unicode61-style words, no stemming, no stopwords
systems.bm25-stem: the same, with Lucene English stopwords, possessives dropped and Porter stemming (Pyserini's default analyzer)

caveats: Not the MemDerive dataset: the paper and its code could not be read where this was written. The questions are ours.
Retrieval only: a question counts as answerable when every event it needs is in the first k. No model read or answered anything.
The needed events are the whole history of what the question asks about, so a reader shown them can always derive the answer; some answers could be derived from fewer.
36 questions: one question is 2.8 points, so a difference of one or two questions is noise.

metrics.full: every event the question needs is among the first k
metrics.recall: the share of the needed events among the first k (mean over questions)
metrics.currentFirst: for questions with superseded values: every needed value that replaced older ones is among the first k and ranks above each of them that is
